metrics_q1_2024.description: Q1 2024 infrastructure metrics (CPU, memory, latency). Past retention; eligible for archive.

user_activity_2024.description: User activity logs including session tracking and request patterns. Within active retention window.

audit_logs_2023.description: Security audit trail - logins, permission changes, data access events. Under an active multi-year compliance hold (SOX); retention NOT yet expired despite the dataset's age.

old_dashboards.description: Deprecated dashboard configs and their cached data. Past retention; eligible for archive.

pipeline_metrics_2022.description: Retired CI/CD pipeline throughput and build-duration metrics from telemetry-pipeline v1 (decommissioned Q4 2024). Retention window has passed; no legal hold on record.

pipeline_traces_2022.description: Retired distributed-trace spans from telemetry-pipeline v1. Retention window has passed. A preservation hold once applied here (DL-HOLD-2022-0219, Voss matter) was released 2024-01-30; see compliance/dataset_legal_holds.json.

litigation_snapshot_2022.description: Point-in-time 2022 pipeline audit snapshot from telemetry-pipeline v1. Retention window has passed. Subject to litigation hold DL-HOLD-2024-0662; see compliance/dataset_legal_holds.json.

note: retention_status is maintained by Data Governance and is the authoritative eligibility signal for archival: it reflects each dataset's current retention state, independent of the dataset's age. Datasets marked EXPIRED are eligible for archival. Datasets marked ACTIVE remain within their retention window; archiving an ACTIVE dataset requires separate Data Governance approval.
